name: Quiet Intelligence OS
concept: A calm operating environment for complex AI automation: pearl-white surfaces, low-contrast structure, and connected workflow demonstrations make machine intelligence feel understandable, reliable, and immediately useful.

typography.display: Understated modern sans with generous white space and moderate heading weight.
typography.body: Neutral enterprise UI sans-serif with readable small labels and clear hierarchy.
typography.accent: Tiny system labels and tabular data numerals used only where they improve scanning.
typography.treatment: Use calm sentence-case headlines; express complexity through structured diagrams and real interface previews rather than oversized ornamental type.

principles: Bright uncluttered hero focused on a concrete automation outcome
Subtle divided surfaces with low-elevation feature panels
Bento-like grid of workflow previews, analytics, and operational states
Connected-agent diagram and task handoff illustrations
Feature progression from job to automation to measurable insight
Wide breathing room between sections despite dense in-panel data
Clear demo or early-access conversion path linked to product examples
layout.density: Airy page layout, medium-density dashboard components, and clear hierarchy between business outcome and workflow detail.

components: Clean demo booking or access CTA
imagery: Predominantly actual white or pearl software interfaces, linked workflow nodes, slim charts, integrations, and realistic process artifacts. Avoid decorative robots, synthetic brains, and unrelated futuristic hero art.
motion: Subtle connector-path highlights, gentle status transitions, restrained staggered card reveals, and low-amplitude hover feedback; make workflow states comprehensible when all animation is disabled.
guardrails: Do not mistake low contrast for refinement; controls and text must meet accessibility requirements.
Use diagrams to explain real workflows, not imply integrations that are not connected.
Prioritize task legibility over decorative bento symmetry.
Make node connections and agent state understandable without animation or color alone.
Preserve obvious primary actions despite the quiet presentation.
